recognize_zh: 血片中到處都是一端拉尖的淚滴狀紅血球（dacrocytes），並可見未成熟的骨髓球（myelocyte）與偏多的血小板，這種白紅血球母細胞樣（leukoerythroblastic）變化加上淚滴細胞，強烈提示骨髓纖維化。
features: Numerous teardrop poikilocytes (dacrocytes) with single tapered tails
Anisopoikilocytosis with occasional larger polychromatic red cells
Circulating immature granulocytes: myelocytes with round-oval nuclei and granular cytoplasm
Platelets appear increased, with some variation in size including enlarged forms
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked poikilocytosis with numerous teardrop cells (dacrocytes) and mild anisocytosis with scattered polychromatic macrocytes. Immature granulocytes, including myelocytes, are present alongside mature neutrophils, indicating a leukoerythroblastic picture; nucleated red cells are not seen in this field. Platelets appear increased with some size variation. No blasts are identified in this field. Findings are suggestive of primary myelofibrosis; bone marrow biopsy with reticulin staining and JAK2/CALR/MPL testing are recommended.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma or other marrow infiltration (myelophthisis)
ddx.vs: Myelophthisic anemia produces the same leukoerythroblastic picture with dacrocytes, so marrow biopsy showing tumor cells rather than atypical megakaryocytes with driver mutations is needed.
Morphology is identical; the distinction depends on a documented prior history of PV or ET.
CML shows a much higher leukocytosis with a full spectrum of granulocytes, basophilia and few teardrop cells, and is BCR::ABL1 positive.
These produce dacrocytes but with target cells/microcytosis or oval macrocytes and hypersegmented neutrophils, without circulating myelocytes and thrombocytosis.
